title: A visible focus ring
summary: outline with outline-offset on :focus-visible: a clear ring for keyboard users that shifts nothing.
explanation: Keyboard users need to see which control has focus. outline is ideal: it takes no space, so drawing it never moves anything, and outline-offset leaves a gap so the ring stands out even against a button of the same colour.
:focus-visible shows the ring when the browser judges it helpful (keyboard navigation) but not after a mouse click. Click into the preview and press Tab to move between the buttons.
The last button has the .demo-focus class, which applies the same ring permanently so you can see it without tabbing. cursor: pointer tells mouse users the buttons are clickable.
tryThis: Click in the preview and press Tab: the ring moves from button to button.
Replace outline with border: 3px solid: the button grows and its neighbours move.
